features.name: News reading
features.description: Discover, filter, preview and save published stories; manage a persistent reading queue and inspect feed freshness.

flows.name: Discover and read
flows.description: Discover current stories, preview them without losing your place, and save a browser-local reading queue.

steps.name: Discover and filter
steps.action: Select country/category, search stories and filter sources.

steps.name: Preview and save
steps.action: Read the supplied summary, open the publisher or save the story.

steps.name: Browse saved stories
steps.action: Search saved stories and filter read/unread state.

steps.name: Manage reading data
steps.action: Mark stories read, remove stories and export/import validated reading data.

steps.name: Refresh feed
steps.action: Load a validated feed, cancel superseded requests, and retain the last successful result on failure.

steps.name: Inspect freshness
steps.action: Inspect real refresh timestamps and provider outcomes.
